reviews.text: I left my dog ​​with Dorine on the recommendation of a friend. Everything went very well, communication with Dorine was easy, and the dogs were happy. I highly recommend her for quality dog-sitting experiences!

Nature walks with Dodog are exceptional; the dogs are so happy to stroll with their friends, surrounded by all the scents of spring, and the freedom to wander through the groves or cool off in the streams...it's a dream come true for our dog! Returning home, the evening is then calm and well-deserved!
I highly recommend introducing your beloved dog to this Dodog experience ;))

Dorine is a trustworthy person, passionate about dogs and deeply committed to their well-being. Always attentive, gentle, and professional, she cares for each dog as if it were her own.
I have complete confidence in her and entrust my dog ​​to her with total peace of mind. I recommend her without hesitation!
